name: case assembly
description: Builds a case in the holder pocket: front case, button, PCB, back case, screws. So far the steps for the two cases exist.
about: An application: one job and its environment, in one folder that can be copied, saved and shared. This file says what it is; layout.json what stands where; grippers/ and items/ hold one folder per gripper and per kind of thing (its description and meshes); steps/ the steps; robots/ what was taught on a particular robot; print/ the CAD the items are made from; notes/ the agents' notes; materials/ what was attached in the chat. Every pose is in the table frame, so the application does not depend on which robot runs it; 'robot' names the one it is set up on now.

conventions.rpy: fixed-axis roll, pitch, yaw: R = Rz(yaw) . Ry(pitch) . Rx(roll) (as URDF); a pose maps the item's frame into its parent
conventions.mesh_frame: each mesh is in the frame its pose places (flange frame for the flange stack and tools, the fixture's or part's own frame otherwise): metres, z up. GLB vertex data is stored in that frame as is (NOT turned to glTF's y-up).
conventions.collision_stl: metres, same frame as the GLB; every connected component is one convex piece
conventions.table: breadboard frame: origin at the lattice corner the cell calls (0, 0), x and y along the hole lattice, z up from the plate top
